using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Jellyfin.Data.Entities;
using Jellyfin.Extensions;
using Jellyfin.Server.Implementations;
using Jellyfin.Server.Media;
using MediaBrowser.Controller;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Library;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Persistence;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Dto;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Querying;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Media.Libraries
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Manages libraries.
    /// </summary>
    public class LibraryManager : ILibraryManager
    {
        private readonly ILogger _logger;
        private readonly IServerApplicationPaths _appPaths;
        private readonly IDbContextFactory _dbContextFactory;
        private readonly ILibraryMonitor _libraryMonitor;
        private readonly IItemRepository _itemRepository;
        private readonly IUserManager _userManager;
        private readonly ILibraryManager _self;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="LibraryManager"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="loggerFactory">The logger factory.</param>
        /// <param name="appPaths">The application paths.</param>
        /// <param name="dbContextFactory">The database context factory.</param>
        /// <param name="libraryMonitor">The library monitor.</param>
        /// <param name="itemRepository">The item repository.</param>
        /// <param name="userManager">The user manager.</param>
        public LibraryManager(
            ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
            IServerApplicationPaths appPaths,
            IDbContextFactory dbContextFactory,
            ILibraryMonitor libraryMonitor,
            IItemRepository itemRepository,
            IUserManager userManager)
        {
            _logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger<LibraryManager>();
            _appPaths = appPaths;
            _dbContextFactory = dbContextFactory;
            _libraryMonitor = libraryMonitor;
            _itemRepository = itemRepository;
            _userManager = userManager;
            _self = this;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets an item by its id.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="id">The id of the item.</param>
        /// <returns>The item, or null if not found.</returns>
        public BaseItem GetItemById(Guid id)
        {
            using var context = _dbContextFactory.CreateDbContext();

            return context.BaseItems
                .Include(i => i.Collections)
                .Include(i => i.Chapters)
                .Include(i => i.MediaSources)
                .Include(i => i.People)
                .Include(i => i.Genres)
                .Include(i => i.Studios)
                .Include(i => i.Tags)
                .FirstOrDefault(i => i.Id == id);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Deletes items.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="items">The items to delete.</param>
        public void DeleteItemsUnsafeFast(IEnumerable<BaseItem> items)
        {
            using var context = _dbContextFactory.CreateDbContext();

            foreach (var item in items)
            {
                context.BaseItems.Remove(item);
            }

            context.SaveChanges();
        }
    }
}
